camel_example: aliyun gwlb AddServersToServerGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Servers.1.ServerType Ecs --Servers.1.ServerId 'i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --Servers.1.Port 6081 --ServerGroupId 'sgp-atstuj3rtoptyui0000' --Servers.1.ServerIp '192.168.XX.XX' --method POST --force
description_en: Adds backend servers to a server group
description_zh: 向负载均衡服务器组中添加后端服务器
kebab_example: aliyun gwlb add-servers-to-server-group --server-group-id sgp-atstuj3rtoptyui0000 --servers ServerType=Ecs ServerId=i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 Port=6081 ServerIp=192.168.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddServersToServerGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the server group
parameters.name: server_group_id

fields.help_en:
The port that is used by the backend server. Valid values:

6081
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器使用的端口，取值：

6081
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The ID of the backend server.

If the server group is of the Instance type, this parameter specifies the ID of an ECS instance, an ENI, or an ECI instance.

If the server group is of the Ip type, this parameter specifies an IP address
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器ID。

当服务器组为Instance类型时，该参数为Ecs、Eni、Eci的资源ID。

当服务器组为Ip类型时，该参数为IP地址
fields.name: server_id

fields.help_en: The IP address of the backend server
fields.name: server_ip

fields.help_en:
The type of the backend server. Valid values:

Ecs: an ECS instance.

Eni: an elastic network interface (ENI).

Eci: an elastic container instance.

Ip: an IP address
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器类型，取值：

Ecs：ECS实例。
Eni：ENI弹性网卡实例。
Eci：ECI弹性容器。
Ip：Ip地址
fields.name: server_type

parameters.help_en:
The backend servers.

You can specify up to 200 backend servers in each call
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务器列表。

单次调用最多支持传入200个服务器
parameters.name: servers

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): sends the request. If the request passes the check, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会向服务器组中添加后端服务器。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
